description: Migrate from in-tree EBS CSI driver to the out-of-tree EBS CSI driver on a production EKS cluster with 200 PersistentVolumes. Must: install ebs-csi-driver via Helm, create new StorageClass pointing to the new driver, migrate existing PVs by creating new volumes from snapshots, update PVCs to reference new StorageClass, verify data integrity, and decommission the old in-tree driver. Risk factors: PV migration requires pod restarts, snapshot-to-restore can fail on large volumes, application downtime during PVC swap, zone/availability-zone mismatch between old and new volumes. Tools available: Helm, kubectl, aws CLI, velero, eksctl.
